## Overview

An intelligent agent system combining the Model Context Protocol (MCP) with real-time air quality data to provide personalized health recommendations for outdoor activities. Built with Python, async architecture, and the API Ninjas Air Quality API.

## Technical Architecture

```
┌─────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────┐
│   User Query    │───▶│  MCP Server     │───▶│ API Ninjas API  │
│ (City/Compare)  │    │ (Data Bridge)   │    │ (Live Data)     │
└─────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘
                                │
                                ▼
                       ┌─────────────────┐
                       │  Health Engine  │
                       │  (WHO/EPA Rules)│
                       └─────────────────┘
                                │
                                ▼
                       ┌─────────────────┐
                       │   Response      │
                       │  + Advice       │
                       └─────────────────┘
```

### Core Components

**1. AQI MCP Server** (`aqi_mcp_server.py`)
- Asynchronous API integration with aiohttp
- Geocoding for city → GPS coordinate conversion
- Real-time air quality data retrieval
- Health category classification (Good, Moderate, Unhealthy, etc.)
- Activity-specific recommendation engine

**2. Interactive Demo** (`aqi_demo.py`)
- Two modes: Interactive and Quick Report
- Multi-city comparison with rankings
- Color-coded terminal output
- Comprehensive error handling

**3. Data Model** (AQIData class)
```python
@dataclass
class AQIData:
    location: str
    latitude: float
    longitude: float
    overall_aqi: int
    co_concentration: float
    no2_concentration: float
    o3_concentration: float
    so2_concentration: float
    pm2_5_concentration: float
    pm10_concentration: float
    timestamp: str
```

## Installation & Quick Start

### Prerequisites
```bash
pip install aiohttp
```

### Get API Key
1. Sign up at [API Ninjas](https://api.api-ninjas.com)
2. Get your free API key
3. Set environment variable:
```bash
export API_NINJAS_KEY='your_key_here'
```

### Run the Demo
```bash
# Quick Report
python3 aqi_demo.py quick

# Interactive Mode
python3 aqi_demo.py
```

## Real-World Use Cases## Real-World Use Cases

### 1. Daily Health Management
**Scenario**: "Should I go jogging this morning?"

The system provides instant analysis:
- Current AQI level for your location
- Specific advice for jogging/running
- Best time windows for outdoor exercise
- Alternative indoor options if needed

**Real Example** (Dhaka, AQI 116):
> "Sensitive individuals should reduce jogging duration or exercise indoors. Consider indoor cycling if you have respiratory conditions."

### 2. Travel Planning
**Scenario**: "Which city has better air quality: Boston or Los Angeles?"

Multi-city comparison shows:
- Boston: AQI 45 (Good) - Perfect for outdoor activities
- Los Angeles: AQI 112 (Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups) - Limited outdoor time recommended

**Decision**: Boston offers significantly better conditions for travelers with respiratory concerns.

### 3. Family Safety
**Scenario**: "Is it safe to take my kids to the playground?"

Sensitive group guidance provides:
- Real-time safety assessment
- Protective measures if needed (masks, timing)
- Alternative indoor activities
- Hourly recommendations

## Gen AI Conversational Agent

Building on the core MCP architecture, this project features AI-powered natural language understanding using OpenAI GPT. The Gen AI agent transforms raw air quality data into personalized, contextual health advice through natural conversations.

### What Makes It Gen AI

<div class="feature-grid">

<div class="feature-card">
<div class="feature-title">Natural Language Understanding</div>
<div class="feature-description">
Ask questions in plain English with no commands to memorize. The AI understands context and intent.
</div>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<div class="feature-title">Personalized Recommendations</div>
<div class="feature-description">
Tailored advice based on your health conditions, activities, and concerns (asthma, allergies, age, etc.)
</div>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<div class="feature-title">Contextual Intelligence</div>
<div class="feature-description">
Combines real-time data with medical knowledge, considers multiple factors for nuanced advice
</div>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<div class="feature-title">Conversation Memory</div>
<div class="feature-description">
Maintains context across multi-turn conversations for follow-up questions and clarifications
</div>
</div>

</div>

### Live Gen AI Conversations

#### Example 1: Simple Air Quality Check

<div class="output-box">
User: What's the air quality like in Boston today?

AI Assistant:
Great news. The air quality in Boston is currently excellent 
with an AQI of 47, which falls in the Good category.

Here's what this means for you:
Air is safe for everyone. All outdoor activities are perfectly fine.
PM2.5: 0.7 µg/m³ (very low particulate matter)
Ozone: 56.3 µg/m³ (within safe limits)

**Key Difference**: The Gen AI agent provides empathetic, conversational responses that explain why and what to do, not just data dumps.

<div class="demo-section">

#### Example 2: Health-Specific Personalized Advice

<div class="output-box">
User: I have asthma. Can I go jogging in Dhaka today?

AI Assistant:
I would advise caution for jogging in Dhaka today. The current AQI 
is 116, which is in the Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups category.

Since you have asthma, here is what I recommend:

Today's Conditions:
AQI: 116 (Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups)
PM2.5: 48.9 µg/m³ (elevated particulate matter)
PM10: 58.6 µg/m³ (elevated)

Jogging Recommendations:
1. Best option: Exercise indoors today (gym, treadmill, indoor track)
2. If you must jog outside:
   Go early morning or late evening when AQI is typically better
   Keep it short (15-20 minutes max)
   Stay at a comfortable pace, avoid intense exertion
   Carry your inhaler
   Monitor how you feel, stop if you experience any symptoms

3. Watch for symptoms: Coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath, 
   or chest tightness mean you should stop immediately

Better days ahead: Check the AQI forecast, it might improve 
in the next day or two. Your health comes first.
</div>

**Intelligence at Work**: The AI understands the user has a pre-existing condition and provides risk assessment specific to asthma, tiered recommendations (best to acceptable), symptom monitoring guidance, and empathetic, safety-first messaging.

</div>
